info.description: Authoritative machine-readable contract. All routes are tenant scoped and deny by default.

CommandRequest.description: Operation-specific JSON request. Unknown fields are rejected by the HTTP decoder where the operation uses a strict DTO.

get.description: Typed, closed extension schema of a capability the organization has enabled (schemaId CODE.vN, supported versions, restricted visibility, proof types). A disabled capability is a 404.
Specialized extension data of one common order, across enabled capabilities. Restricted (medical, passenger) records are access-audited.

post.description: Validates capabilityCode/recordType/payload against the capability schema (schemaVersion defaults to the current version; unsupported fields are rejected) and stores it as an extension of the order. Emits specialized_order.validated.
